doc.native: Real 1x emulator output (was a 256x240 placeholder that corrupted integer placement).

render_scale.doc: Dolphin's 2x EFB (1280x1056) already passes the Deck's 800 lines and suits 1080p; 3x (nine times the fill) is past the Deck's GPU in most games.

doc.intent: Dolphin is pinned to draw 4:3 (CustomStretch in GFX.ini) until it reports the aspect it draws; then its aspect setting can drive 4:3 vs 16:9 presentation.
doc.extensions: Only formats Dolphin opens: a .7z or .zip ends in "Could not recognize file" and a modal "Failed to init core", so neither is offered. .wad and .wbfs stay because Dolphin boots them as Wii titles. Dolphin reads .m3u itself.
